title: Draw the Journey · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw the Journey · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a short familiar journey, such as from home to a park. The lead draws three landmarks in order along a path. The others identify the intended journey and landmark order. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw the Journey, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The others identify the intended journey and landmark order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The others identify the intended journey and landmark order.
